_note: F5 weather and what to wear. Forecast from Open-Meteo, no key [assumption: free for non-commercial use, credit asked; its terms could not be read from the build session, 2 Nov]. All wording and thresholds are proposals: change them freely. 'places' are the two hotels' districts (North Point, Nanshan) [assumption: approximate coordinates; weather is per city, so precision doesn't matter].
_forecast_days_note: Open-Meteo's longest forecast [assumption: its documented maximum, from memory]. With 16 days the trip preview shows the real forecast for a day up to about two weeks ahead, and phones keep the whole trip's forecast for offline use once it is in range.
flight_wear: Keep a jacket handy on the plane.
_sky_note: WMO weather codes, as Open-Meteo reports them. A 'wet' sky already says rain, so 'rain likely' isn't added; the umbrella line is.

wear.text: Light clothes. Drink plenty of water.

_wear_note: Chosen by the day's high (°C): the first row whose 'from' it reaches.
